subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Which durable subagent completion delivery policy should own this umbrella before any retry-only or auto-restart fix is accepted?
rationale: The current bug is real, but the permanent fix changes at-least-once delivery, visible failure semantics, timeout/restart behavior, task-ledger states, and duplicate-prevention across agent and channel surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and require a durable outbox/spool or equivalent closed delivery-state design before landing partial retry changes.

options.title: Narrow to the linked retry PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 as the near-term candidate only after conflicts, real behavior proof, and duplicate-send risk are resolved.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Move timeout auto-restart, active-run consumption races, restart/orphan durability, and file-claim verification into separate canonical issues before closing the umbrella.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and require a durable outbox/spool or equivalent closed delivery-state design before landing partial retry changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete as the broadest owner for the subagent lifecycle/delivery boundary and the product-level duplicate-vs-durability choice.
